title: A gondola glimpse
notes: Bowl Gondola tower 1 (3222.2, 1127.7, -2378.1), seen from the southeast at cabin height, 33.5 m out: a short orbit from -35 to -22 degrees around the tower (block A's longer orbit started at -46 degrees, where a fir crown fills the lower left). Stills of the start, middle and end (shoot view c1-03a-abc, c1-03a-de) show no tree in front of the cabins; firs and the Summit Lodge stand behind them. Ground under the keys: 1123.0, 1124.5, 1125.9. Ascending cabins (x rising) run on the south rope (z about -2391 at x 3203), about 5.4 m/s at sim speed 1, one every 12 s or so. Start the sequence when an ascending SkiGondolaCabin8 passes x 3203 to 3209 (poll the cabin entities with `entity`; take 3 fired at x 3203.06): the sequence hides the UI, waits 30 frames, runs the 6 s path; the cabin passes the tower head at about 3.5 to 4.5 s of the path. Take 4 is the 60 mm variant at Time of Day 11.5 in alt60. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
